description.value: Participants viewed smoking-related, positive, negative, and neutral images in blocks.

spans.text: Stimuli were presented in a blocked design, and each block consisted of 10 3-s stimuli of the same type.

Stimuli included smoking-related and neutral pictures selected from the International Smoking Image Series (ISIS; ) and affective stimuli (positive [erotic] and negative [mutilation]) selected from the International Affective Picture System (IAPS; ) and an in-house picture set.
